result.summary: Pass 3 over rework 01f: `git diff 043c612 84fe178 -- docs/design/M2AUTH-accounts-tenancy-backup.md` read whole (sha256 of the design at 84fe178: 0e9c89e53226e15e0bbb5a724a4359770333d4477e8712148d87ac7154dde326, before and after). P1 fixed: the list is the module app/server/auth/common-passwords.js (one frozen export COMMON_PASSWORDS, header with the source, the commit and the full MIT text), imported by password.js with no fs read; C20, §3, 4.9.2, PW-4, A21, B6 and §17 follow it; no `.txt` is left in the design (grep 0); REQ-114 names the same module (3 places). This matches decisions/0137 Addition 2 «N2b, form of the list», so IB-1 stays green. P2 fixed: the login's first read of users is unlocked; the lock is taken on the one row that holds the counter (the ordinary users row read again under the lock, the login_failures row, or for the admin the login_delays row of the address made by insert … on conflict do nothing then select … for update); the admin's users row is never locked by a login (grep of the old sentence: 0); login_delays.fails ≥ 0; the delay formula on the locked row keeps REQ-114 c5's 2^(n−1) s; one counter-row lock per request after the rate row and before the audit lock, so no reverse wait; AUTH-RACE-3 restated, AUTH-RACE-4 added (a right admin login from a clean address answers 200 within 4 s while six other addresses fail in parallel); M52 restated, M52b added. Not measurable here (no Postgres): the pg job proves it, named so in the design. R1-R4 done: one vCPU named in 4.9.2, §7 and §14 with F32 (re-run on my clone: eight parallel computations on one thread end at 540 … 3982, 4628 ms); the full MIT notice in the header (PW-4 checks it); traces run over the module before its commit (B6); the deadline answer switched off once COMMIT is sent, with an ADD-2 case for a COMMIT in flight. The generated sample of the module passes the pinned prettier (re-run). Nothing else changed that weakens the design: the other hunks only close О15/О16 (answered by decisions/0137 Addition 2; REQ-114 amended in dfd23bc), update counts (62 mutants) and add the section-19 table. Criteria 32 of 32, the bar section, the replacement table and the earlier fixes B1-B7, N1-N6 stay as passed in pass 2.
